title: Sparse cubical complexes for efficient topology-preservation in image data
abstract: arXiv:2609.37177v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Persistent homology (PH) is a frequently used tool for extracting and preserving topological information from image data, particularly in image segmentation, where preservation of topological structures is important. However, despite its general applicability across dimensionality, domains, and target structures, the runtime cost of PH-based methods often makes their practical use infeasible. In this work, we argue that this runtime cost is largely driven by processing information that is unimportant for downstream application (e.g. as optimization objective). We propose sparse cubical filtrations as an alternative foundation for PH computation, reducing subsequent computational costs by factors of up to 100 on real datasets. translated_title: 用于图像数据中高效拓扑保持的稀疏立方复形
translated_abstract: 持续同调（PH）是一种常用的工具，用于从图像数据中提取和保持拓扑信息，尤其是在拓扑结构保持至关重要的图像分割任务中。然而，尽管持续同调在维度、领域和目标结构方面具有广泛的适用性，基于持续同调的方法的运行时间成本往往使其在实际应用中不可行。在这项工作中，我们认为这种运行时间成本主要来源于对下游应用（例如作为优化目标）并不重要的信息的处理。我们提出稀疏立方过滤作为持续同调计算的替代基础，在真实数据集上将后续计算成本降低了高达100倍。我们展示了该方法与稠密对应方法的优化信号高度一致，并在现实训练环境中实证评估了我们解决方案作为优化目标的有效性。
tldr: 提出稀疏立方过滤作为持续同调计算的替代基础，在保持与稠密方法一致的优化信号的同时，将真实数据集上的计算成本降低高达100倍。
en_tdlr: Proposes sparse cubical filtrations as an alternative foundation for persistent homology computation, reducing computational costs by up to 100x on real datasets while closely matching the optimization signals of dense counterparts.
